events.label: A cargo jet overran Miami's runway, struck vehicles, and killed five people on the ground

slots.name: runway distance
slots.sentence: The airplane traveled 1,300 feet past the paved surface of the airport, she said.

slots.name: crew members
slots.sentence: It was on its third flight of the day and was arriving in Miami from San Juan, Puerto Rico, with two crew members on board.

slots.name: van occupants
slots.sentence: NTSB Chairwoman Jennifer Homendy told reporters at a press conference Monday that the plane overran the runway, hitting navigational aids and equipment before striking a white van with seven people aboard within the airport perimeter.

events.label: NTSB begins investigation into Miami Amazon cargo plane crash

slots.name: investigator count
slots.sentence: Thirty-two NTSB investigators have arrived at the scene, which she said was covered with fuel.

slots.name: report timeline
slots.sentence: Fuel was also being removed from the aircraft, she said.

slots.name: recorders recovered
slots.sentence: Investigators have recovered the flight data and cockpit voice recorders from an Amazon Prime cargo plane that crashed while landing in Miami over the weekend, the National Transportation Safety Board said as it began its investigation into the incident.

slots.name: recovery status
slots.sentence: A final report is typically made public within 12 and 24 months of the crash.
